beats.text: Thatha wrote every night for fifty years.
Notebooks under the bed. 400 pages. Nobody read them.
"Who reads an old man's stories?" he said.
His granddaughter typed them up. One page a night.
On his 80th birthday, she handed him a book with his name on the cover.
beats.small: It's never too late to be an author.

end.text: Who in your family should write their story?
